defect: Old resolved command anchor is paired with current measurement at a newly opened epoch; expected motion since old command reference is compared with measured motion since newer measurement reference.
trace_limitation: Reconstructed unchanged scenario prefix to first FAULT, not a byte-for-byte failed-production capture; development regression evidence only, not hardware/OEM/NVIDIA/GB300 evidence.

resolved_pair.creation: First directly observed valid released PLC command and released measurement already within frozen tracking tolerance, or first frozen startup obligation that legitimately resolves; no fabricated PLC history.
resolved_pair.advancement: One atomic record at qualified epoch resolution to STEADY_TRACKING within frozen tolerance, with both current released command and current valid released measurement. Never advance for partial progress, command update, reversal, invalid measurement or timer expiry.

progress_pair.creation: At first cumulative same-direction epoch copy the latest resolved pair atomically; at material reversal use the current valid released command/measurement observation atomically and retain any prior unresolved watch age/evidence. If no resolved pair exists, use the first valid released observation pair and preserve startup handoff rules.
progress_pair.advancement: After qualified directional measured progress, atomically replace both references with the released command and valid released measurement from that same evaluation tick; command-only updates and invalid measurement never advance it.
progress_pair.credited_motion: Keep ledger of cumulative signed qualified measurement displacement from resolved pair and prior checkpoints; a checkpoint refresh never deletes previously credited motion.

comparison_rules: Gross cumulative command demand = current released command - resolved command anchor; materiality uses frozen material delta and response-open model.
At initial same-direction epoch compare directed command and measurement displacement from the same resolved pair, never from different timestamps.

During unresolved response use command increment since progress checkpoint plus the nonnegative directional command-minus-measurement debt stored in that same pair. Compare with directed measured increment since that pair; retain already-qualified measured motion in a ledger. At material reversal establish a fresh current-observation progress pair but retain prior no-motion watch age/evidence.
Use frozen minimum observable motion, directional ratio, expected response model, suspect/confirm thresholds and sample count; no new numeric parameter or instantaneous-error health shortcut.

For no-motion evidence, keep oldest unresolved demand/watch age and suspicion count across checkpoint refresh, same-direction command updates and reversal. Qualified progress does not clear the unresolved watch until the epoch is within frozen tracking tolerance and resolves to STEADY_TRACKING. A checkpoint refresh is not an obligation resolution.

A plateau remains unresolved until qualified progress and frozen tracking-tolerance resolution; its outstanding paired command-minus-measurement debt is evaluated using frozen response model and original unresolved age, not a fresh checkpoint grace.
sensor_rules: Invalid measurement yields INSUFFICIENT_MEASUREMENT and freezes both pairs, watch, suspicion and oldest demand; recovered valid measurement resumes existing context with no synthetic baseline.
reversal_rules: Material reversal changes epoch direction but not resolved pair; preserve unresolved no-motion watch and suspicion unless qualified prior motion legitimately resolves that watch; new progress pair must be an atomic causal observation pair.
tune01_acceptance: In-domain reconstructed trace must never reach TRACKING_FAULT_CONFIRMED; report any TRACKING_FAULT_SUSPECTED separately; compare old/new every tick around 28-32 seconds.
historical_regressions: C1-C8,C9R,C10-C12 unchanged; original C9 remains INVALID
